finalText:
**Redis went down and took everything with it.**

Everything else follows from that one failure.

```
02:14:07  Redis refuses connections (10.0.0.12:6379)
02:14:07  cache off, reads go straight to the store
02:14:08  cache miss storm, store overloaded, 5s timeouts
02:29:12  queue passes its 500 limit
02:31:44  worker-2 runs out of memory, exit 134
02:31:52  api killed, service down
```

Redis never came back. All 13 reconnect tries were refused.
The queue grew from 52 to 568 and never drained.
The log ends at the kill. No recovery here.

Start with Redis itself, not the app.
